name: behind head chest stretch
description: A seated, partner-assisted chest stretch with the hands behind the head and the elbows gently opened.
instructions: Sit upright with your hands lightly behind your head and your elbows pointing outward.
Have a partner stand behind you and gently guide your elbows back, without pulling on your head or neck.
Keep your ribs down and breathe steadily as the front of your chest opens.
Hold for a comfortable 15 to 30 seconds, then let your partner release the pressure slowly.
